text_block_list.text:
One day, on the way back from buying supplies
like field fertilizer with Katsuragi Ace—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Oh!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
I found the raffle venue!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the fun, fun lottery!
Anyone and everyone, come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, that lottery ticket we got earlier...
Let's put it to good use!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hey, mister!
No one's hit the grand prize yet, right?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah!
There are still plenty of chances left!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Hell yeah!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Let's do this, Trainer!
Our goal is obviously—
choice_data_list: It's the grand prize, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
I'll blaze the trail!

Katsuragi Ace rolled up her sleeves
and spun the raffle wheel!
And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOO!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: High fiiive!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Got 'em!
Now that's what an ace is capable of!
choice_data_list: Now we've got a special reward lined up.
Now we've got a special reward lined up.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: A reward... Yeah, let's see.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
From here, once again,
there are things I must do.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Takkin' it easy is
for after everything's done!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Will you hold onto it for me until then,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...Alright!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Alright, how about stopping by the public bath on the way back!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Even if the reward comes later,
what's the harm in feeling like a grand prize winner now?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I heard before that there's a really great
public bath around here!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Let's go wash off all this sweat and give it our best again tomorrow!
And so, saving the hot springs for the future, we had a grand time at the public bathhouse that day.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
“—Trainer!
Let's go grab some coffee milk!”

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Phaaah!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Ooh, first prize!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
In other words...
it's basically the same as 1st place, right?!
choice_data_list: It's basically like you got 1st place!
It's basically like you got 1st place!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Hell yeah!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: And! The one that won...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: That looks insanely delicious!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I really, really love
hamburg steak!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: The hamburger steaks my mom makes are insanely thick, you know.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
It took an insane amount of time to make...
My sister and I went wild in the kitchen, as I recall.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Pops's hamburger steaks were always packed with veggies!
Man, I loved both so much.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
How about you, Trainer-san?
Do you have any memories of it?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, then hey!
Let's make brand-new memories today!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Grilling and eating it together
is bound to make a fun memory!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —Mmh~~!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
This is crazy good!
Right, Trainer?!

That night, I ate hamburg steaks while chatting
with Katsuragi Ace. That time spent together...
became a precious memory.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Second prize, huh... That's a bit frustrating!
But...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Holy crap!
A mountain of carrots is the absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Right?
It's packed with plenty of our proud, locally grown carrots!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: That's true! Every single one has a great shine and color... These are really good carrots!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: Oh, so you understand, young lady!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
My family runs a farm, after all!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Even I can tell that these were raised with heaps of love and are top-notch!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Alright, after getting praised that much,
I can't just let ya leave empty-handed.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: I'm givin' ya all the veggies I got from the greengrocer earlier, missy!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?!
Nah, you don't gotta do that—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
No, really, it's totally fine!
It makes me happy to hear people praise things from my hometown!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: I'm sure your mom and dad would have done the exact same thing, little lady!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ouss!
Thanks for the treat!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Alright, from the right then!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
To play it safe, stir-fried veggies and lightly pickled cucumber!
I also made some pickled bell peppers!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
And then, stuffed bell peppers, right?
With winter melon soup—

That night, we savored the dishes
Katsuragi Ace whipped up...
and had a delightful vegetable party.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Aww, 3rd prize~?!
choice_data_list: You made it onto the board!
You made it onto the board!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Ah, you're right!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Besides... we've got delicious carrots with us too!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: I know! Let me show you the absolute tastiest way to eat this, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hey mister!
Got a light I could borrow?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —Mmh~, grilled to perfection, if I do say so myself!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you too, Trainer!
Take a bite!
choice_data_list: Biting it is a bit much, though...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"It's fine, it's not hot anymore!
Come on, open wide!"
choice_data_list: ...Just seeing your expression is delicious enough, Ace!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Obviously it tastes better if you eat it.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...Well, fine then!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I'll grill some carrots for you next time.
I'm definitely gonna make you eat 'em!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Uwoooh!?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Seriously...? Aw man...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"You saying...
I don't have what it takes to be an ace...?"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Haaah...

Having tackled it with such high spirits,
Katsuragi Ace ended up feeling
far more downcast than necessary...
